title: Beef Tacos
notes: Warm tortillas on a dry skillet for 30 seconds each side. Top with fresh cilantro and diced onion.

ingredients.name: Ground beef
tips: 80/20 fat ratio gives the best flavour

ingredients.name: Taco seasoning
alternatives: homemade: 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder

ingredients.name: Avocado
tips: Should yield slightly to gentle pressure

steps.description: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. No oil needed — the beef fat will render.
Add ground beef, breaking it into small crumbles with a wooden spoon.
tips: Don't press the meat flat — keeping it loose gives better browning

steps.description: Season with taco seasoning and ½ tsp salt. Stir to coat evenly.
Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is browned and no pink remains.
tips: If excess grease pools, drain it with a slotted spoon

steps.description: While beef cooks, warm tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat, 30 seconds per side.
Slice avocados and limes. Chop cilantro.
Assemble tacos: beef, cheese, salsa, sour cream, avocado slices, a squeeze of lime, and cilantro.
